```{r}
# Model A1 and A2 supplementary tables
# Input files use the confirmed names without extra parenthesised suffixes.
# Run in RStudio with Source, or run:
# Rscript Model_A_tables.R "/path/to/A_Cox_outputs" "/path/to/output"

# 1. File locations --------------------------------------------------------
data_dir <- "/Users/apple/Desktop/Bag/rolling/Postgraduate/ADV/Week 4/data/A_Cox_outputs"
output_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "outputs")

arguments <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(arguments) >= 1) data_dir <- arguments[1]
if (length(arguments) >= 2) output_dir <- arguments[2]
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 2. Packages --------------------------------------------------------------
packages <- c("readxl", "officer", "flextable", "openxlsx")

# Install packages only if they are missing
for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  }
}

# Load packages
library(readxl)
library(officer)
library(flextable)
library(openxlsx)

ever_file <- file.path(data_dir, "A_Ever Dibao_Hukou.xlsx")
never_file <- file.path(data_dir, "A_Never_Dibao_Hukou.xlsx")
interaction_file <- file.path(data_dir, "A_Dibao_Interaction_Hukou.xlsx")
stopifnot(file.exists(ever_file), file.exists(never_file),
          file.exists(interaction_file))

# 3. Read the numeric source results ---------------------------------------
ever <- as.data.frame(read_excel(ever_file, sheet = "Main_Cox"))
never <- as.data.frame(read_excel(never_file, sheet = "Main_Cox"))
a2 <- as.data.frame(read_excel(interaction_file, sheet = "Primary_Level_HRs"))
blocks <- as.data.frame(read_excel(interaction_file, sheet = "Primary_Block"))
samples <- as.data.frame(read_excel(interaction_file, sheet = "Sample_Summary"))
sample_check <- as.data.frame(
  read_excel(interaction_file, sheet = "Phase1_Sample_Check")
)
stopifnot(all(sample_check$matches_phase1))

# 4. Labels and row order ---------------------------------------------------
factor_order <- c("sex", "income_tertile", "marriage_status",
                  "living_children", "coresident_child", "hukou")
group_labels <- c(
  sex = "Sex (reference Male)",
  income_tertile = "Income (reference T1)",
  marriage_status = "Marital status (reference Partnered)",
  living_children = "Living children (reference 0)",
  coresident_child = "Child coresidence (reference No)",
  hukou = "Hukou (reference Non-agricultural)"
)

labels1 <- data.frame(
  factor = c("sex", rep("income_tertile", 2), rep("marriage_status", 3),
             rep("living_children", 4), rep("coresident_child", 2), "hukou"),
  term = c("sexFemale", "income_tertileT2", "income_tertileT3",
           "marriage_statusWidowed", "marriage_statusSeparated-Divorced",
           "marriage_statusNever married", "living_children1",
           "living_children2", "living_children3+", "living_childrenUnknown",
           "coresident_childYes", "coresident_childUnknown", "hukouAgricultural"),
  label = c("Female", "T2", "T3", "Widowed", "Separated/Divorced",
            "Never married", "1 child", "2 children", "3+ children", "Unknown",
            "Yes", "Unknown", "Agricultural"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

labels2 <- data.frame(
  factor = c("sex", rep("income_tertile", 2), rep("marriage_status", 3),
             rep("living_children", 3), "coresident_child", "hukou"),
  comparison = c(
    "Sex: Female vs Male", "Income: T2 vs T1", "Income: T3 vs T1",
    "Marriage: Widowed vs Partnered",
    "Marriage: Separated-Divorced vs Partnered",
    "Marriage: Never married vs Partnered",
    "Living children: 1 vs 0", "Living children: 2 vs 0",
    "Living children: 3+ vs 0", "Coresident child: Yes vs No",
    "HUKOU: Agricultural vs Non-agricultural"
  ),
  label = c("Female", "T2", "T3", "Widowed", "Separated/Divorced",
            "Never married", "1 child", "2 children", "3+ children",
            "Yes", "Agricultural"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Match by names, so the source row order cannot change the comparisons.
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(ever$term), !anyDuplicated(never$term),
          !anyDuplicated(a2$comparison), !anyDuplicated(blocks$factor))
stopifnot(setequal(ever$term, labels1$term),
          setequal(never$term, labels1$term),
          setequal(a2$comparison, labels2$comparison),
          setequal(blocks$factor, factor_order))
ever <- ever[match(labels1$term, ever$term), ]
never <- never[match(labels1$term, never$term), ]
a2 <- a2[match(labels2$comparison, a2$comparison), ]
blocks <- blocks[match(factor_order, blocks$factor), ]
stopifnot(identical(a2$factor, labels2$factor))

# 5. Check the values used in the tables ------------------------------------
numeric_columns <- c("beta", "robust_se", "HR", "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value")
for (data in list(ever, never)) {
  stopifnot(all(numeric_columns %in% names(data)),
            all(is.finite(as.matrix(data[numeric_columns]))),
            all(data$HR > 0), all(data$lower_95 > 0),
            all(data$lower_95 <= data$HR), all(data$HR <= data$upper_95),
            all(data$p_value >= 0 & data$p_value <= 1),
            isTRUE(all.equal(data$HR, exp(data$beta), tolerance = 1e-7)))
}
a2_columns <- c("Never_HR", "Never_lower_95", "Never_upper_95", "Never_p",
                "Ever_HR", "Ever_lower_95", "Ever_upper_95", "Ever_p",
                "HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never", "ratio_lower_95", "ratio_upper_95",
                "interaction_p")
stopifnot(all(a2_columns %in% names(a2)),
          all(is.finite(as.matrix(a2[a2_columns]))),
          all(is.finite(blocks$p_value)),
          all(blocks$p_value >= 0 & blocks$p_value <= 1),
          all(a2$interaction_p >= 0 & a2$interaction_p <= 1),
          isTRUE(all.equal(a2$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never,
                           a2$Ever_HR / a2$Never_HR, tolerance = 1e-7)))
for (prefix in c("Never", "Ever")) {
  stopifnot(all(a2[[paste0(prefix, "_lower_95")]] > 0),
            all(a2[[paste0(prefix, "_lower_95")]] <= a2[[paste0(prefix, "_HR")]]),
            all(a2[[paste0(prefix, "_HR")]] <= a2[[paste0(prefix, "_upper_95")]]))
}
stopifnot(all(a2$ratio_lower_95 > 0),
          all(a2$ratio_lower_95 <= a2$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never),
          all(a2$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never <= a2$ratio_upper_95))

# 6. Display formats -------------------------------------------------------
format_hr <- function(hr, lower, upper) {
  sprintf("%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)", hr, lower, upper)
}
format_p <- function(p) {
  result <- sprintf("%.3f", p)
  near_cutoff <- p >= 0.045 & p <= 0.055
  result[near_cutoff] <- sprintf("%.4f", p[near_cutoff])
  result[p < 0.001] <- "<.001"
  sub("^0", "", result)
}

# 7. Table 1: separate models in the two groups -----------------------------
a1_numeric <- data.frame(
  Factor = labels1$factor, Comparison = labels1$label, Term = labels1$term,
  Never_beta = never$beta, Never_robust_se = never$robust_se,
  Never_HR = never$HR, Never_lower_95 = never$lower_95,
  Never_upper_95 = never$upper_95, Never_p = never$p_value,
  Ever_beta = ever$beta, Ever_robust_se = ever$robust_se,
  Ever_HR = ever$HR, Ever_lower_95 = ever$lower_95,
  Ever_upper_95 = ever$upper_95, Ever_p = ever$p_value
)
a1_display <- data.frame(
  Comparison = paste0("  ", labels1$label),
  Never_HR_CI = format_hr(never$HR, never$lower_95, never$upper_95),
  Never_p = format_p(never$p_value),
  Ever_HR_CI = format_hr(ever$HR, ever$lower_95, ever$upper_95),
  Ever_p = format_p(ever$p_value)
)
table1 <- a1_display[0, ]
group_rows1 <- integer()
for (factor_name in factor_order) {
  group_rows1 <- c(group_rows1, nrow(table1) + 1L)
  heading <- data.frame(Comparison = unname(group_labels[factor_name]),
                        Never_HR_CI = "", Never_p = "",
                        Ever_HR_CI = "", Ever_p = "")
  table1 <- rbind(table1, heading,
                  a1_display[labels1$factor == factor_name, ])
}

# 8. Table 2: pooled stratified interaction models --------------------------
a2_numeric <- a2[c("factor", "comparison", a2_columns)]
a2_numeric$overall_interaction_p <- blocks$p_value[
  match(a2$factor, blocks$factor)
]
a2_display <- data.frame(
  Comparison = paste0("  ", labels2$label),
  Never_HR_CI = format_hr(a2$Never_HR, a2$Never_lower_95, a2$Never_upper_95),
  Ever_HR_CI = format_hr(a2$Ever_HR, a2$Ever_lower_95, a2$Ever_upper_95),
  RHR_CI = format_hr(a2$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never,
                     a2$ratio_lower_95, a2$ratio_upper_95),
  Contrast_p = format_p(a2$interaction_p),
  Overall_p = ""
)
table2 <- a2_display[0, ]
group_rows2 <- integer()
for (factor_name in factor_order) {
  group_rows2 <- c(group_rows2, nrow(table2) + 1L)
  heading <- data.frame(
    Comparison = unname(group_labels[factor_name]),
    Never_HR_CI = "", Ever_HR_CI = "", RHR_CI = "", Contrast_p = "",
    Overall_p = format_p(blocks$p_value[blocks$factor == factor_name])
  )
  table2 <- rbind(table2, heading,
                  a2_display[labels2$factor == factor_name, ])
}

title1 <- "Table 1 Model A1 group-specific mortality associations"
title2 <- "Table 2 Model A2 between-group differences in mortality associations"
stopifnot(setequal(samples$dibao_group, c("Never", "Ever")))
sample_note <- sprintf(
  "Never Dibao: %s respondents and %s deaths. Ever Dibao: %s respondents and %s deaths.",
  format(samples$persons[samples$dibao_group == "Never"], big.mark = ","),
  format(samples$death_events[samples$dibao_group == "Never"], big.mark = ","),
  format(samples$persons[samples$dibao_group == "Ever"], big.mark = ","),
  format(samples$death_events[samples$dibao_group == "Ever"], big.mark = ",")
)
note1 <- paste(
  sample_note,
  "HR = hazard ratio. CI = confidence interval.",
  "Separate Cox models were stratified by age group and adjusted for all six factors.",
  "Standard errors were clustered by individual.",
  "Unknown child-number and coresidence categories were retained as adjustment terms."
)
note2 <- paste(
  sample_note,
  "HR = hazard ratio. CI = confidence interval. RHR = Ever Dibao HR / Never Dibao HR.",
  "Each model tested one factor's interaction with Dibao group, stratified by age group and Dibao group.",
  "Other factor coefficients were shared between groups. Standard errors were clustered by individual.",
  "Contrast p refers to the category-specific interaction. Overall p is the factor-level Wald test.",
  "All p values are unadjusted. Unknown categories were adjustment terms without group interactions."
)
headers1 <- c(Comparison = "Variable or contrast", Never_HR_CI = "HR (95% CI)",
              Never_p = "p", Ever_HR_CI = "HR (95% CI)", Ever_p = "p")
headers2 <- c(Comparison = "Variable or contrast",
              Never_HR_CI = "Never Dibao\nHR (95% CI)",
              Ever_HR_CI = "Ever Dibao\nHR (95% CI)",
              RHR_CI = "Ever/Never\nRHR (95% CI)",
              Contrast_p = "Contrast\np", Overall_p = "Overall\np")
# Convert the explicit newline markers in the column labels.
headers2 <- gsub("\\n", "\n", headers2)

# 9. Word tables -----------------------------------------------------------
make_table <- function(data, headers, groups, widths) {
  ft <- flextable(data)
  ft <- set_header_labels(ft, values = as.list(headers))
  ft <- theme_booktabs(ft)
  ft <- bold(ft, part = "header")
  ft <- font(ft, fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all")
  ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 12, part = "all")
  ft <- color(ft, color = "black", part = "all")
  ft <- bold(ft, i = groups, part = "body")
  ft <- align(ft, align = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- align(ft, j = 1, align = "left", part = "all")
  ft <- valign(ft, valign = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- padding(ft, padding = 2, part = "all")
  ft <- width(ft, j = seq_along(widths), width = widths)
  ft <- set_table_properties(ft, layout = "fixed", align = "center",
                            opts_word = list(split = FALSE))
  paginate(ft, init = FALSE, hdr_ftr = TRUE)
}
ft1 <- make_table(table1, headers1, group_rows1, c(3.5, 2.3, 0.8, 2.3, 0.8))
ft1 <- add_header_row(ft1, values = c("", "Never Dibao", "Ever Dibao"),
                      colwidths = c(1, 2, 2), top = TRUE)
ft1 <- merge_v(ft1, j = 1, part = "header")
ft1 <- bold(ft1, part = "header")
ft1 <- align(ft1, align = "center", part = "header")
ft1 <- align(ft1, j = 1, align = "left", part = "header")
ft1 <- italic(ft1, j = c(3, 5), i = 2, part = "header")
ft2 <- make_table(table2, headers2, group_rows2,
                   c(3.0, 1.75, 1.75, 1.75, 0.85, 0.85))

title_style <- fp_text(font.family = "Times New Roman",
                       font.size = 12, bold = TRUE)
note_style <- fp_text(font.family = "Times New Roman", font.size = 12)
doc <- read_docx()
doc <- body_set_default_section(doc, prop_section(
  page_size = page_size(orient = "landscape"),
  page_margins = page_mar(top = 0.55, bottom = 0.55,
                          left = 0.65, right = 0.65)
))
doc <- body_add_fpar(doc, fpar(ftext(title1, title_style),
                              fp_p = fp_par(keep_with_next = TRUE)))
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft1)
doc <- body_add_fpar(doc, fpar(ftext(note1, note_style)))
doc <- body_add_break(doc)
doc <- body_add_fpar(doc, fpar(ftext(title2, title_style),
                              fp_p = fp_par(keep_with_next = TRUE)))
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft2)
doc <- body_add_fpar(doc, fpar(ftext(note2, note_style)))
word_file <- file.path(output_dir, "Model_A_tables.docx")
print(doc, target = word_file)

# 10. Excel presentation tables and unrounded numeric results ---------------
wb <- createWorkbook()
modifyBaseFont(wb, fontSize = 12, fontName = "Times New Roman")
header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center",
                             valign = "center", wrapText = TRUE,
                             border = "bottom")
group_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold")
note_style_xlsx <- createStyle(wrapText = TRUE, valign = "top")
p_style <- createStyle(numFmt = "0.0000000000")
number_style <- createStyle(numFmt = "0.000000")

add_presentation <- function(wb, sheet, data, headers, groups, title, note, widths) {
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet, gridLines = FALSE)
  writeData(wb, sheet, title, startRow = 1, colNames = FALSE)
  mergeCells(wb, sheet, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), rows = 1)
  addStyle(wb, sheet, group_style, rows = 1, cols = 1)
  names(data) <- unname(headers)
  writeData(wb, sheet, data, startRow = 3, headerStyle = header_style)
  addStyle(wb, sheet, group_style, rows = groups + 3,
           cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
  setColWidths(wb, sheet, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), widths = widths)
  setRowHeights(wb, sheet, rows = 3, heights = 36)
  setRowHeights(wb, sheet, rows = 4:(nrow(data) + 3), heights = 22)
  note_row <- nrow(data) + 5
  writeData(wb, sheet, note, startRow = note_row, colNames = FALSE)
  mergeCells(wb, sheet, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), rows = note_row)
  addStyle(wb, sheet, note_style_xlsx, rows = note_row, cols = 1)
  setRowHeights(wb, sheet, rows = note_row, heights = 105)
  freezePane(wb, sheet, firstActiveRow = 4, firstActiveCol = 2)
  pageSetup(wb, sheet, orientation = "landscape", paperSize = 9,
            fitToWidth = TRUE, fitToHeight = FALSE)
}
excel_headers1 <- c(Comparison = "Variable or contrast",
                    Never_HR_CI = "Never Dibao HR (95% CI)",
                    Never_p = "Never Dibao p",
                    Ever_HR_CI = "Ever Dibao HR (95% CI)",
                    Ever_p = "Ever Dibao p")
add_presentation(wb, "Table 1", table1, excel_headers1, group_rows1,
                  title1, note1, c(48, 29, 17, 29, 17))
add_presentation(wb, "Table 2", table2, headers2, group_rows2,
                  title2, note2, c(48, 29, 29, 29, 15, 15))

numeric_tables <- list(A1_numeric = a1_numeric, A2_numeric = a2_numeric)
source_notes <- c(
  A1_numeric = "Sources: A_Never_Dibao_Hukou.xlsx and A_Ever Dibao_Hukou.xlsx, Main_Cox.",
  A2_numeric = "Source: A_Dibao_Interaction_Hukou.xlsx, Primary_Level_HRs and Primary_Block."
)
for (sheet in names(numeric_tables)) {
  data <- numeric_tables[[sheet]]
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet, gridLines = FALSE)
  writeData(wb, sheet, source_notes[sheet], startRow = 1, colNames = FALSE)
  writeData(wb, sheet, data, startRow = 3, headerStyle = header_style)
  numeric_cols <- which(vapply(data, is.numeric, logical(1)))
  addStyle(wb, sheet, number_style, rows = 4:(nrow(data) + 3),
           cols = numeric_cols, gridExpand = TRUE)
  p_cols <- grep("_p$", names(data))
  addStyle(wb, sheet, p_style, rows = 4:(nrow(data) + 3),
           cols = p_cols, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
  setColWidths(wb, sheet, cols = 1:3, widths = c(23, 52, 38))
  setColWidths(wb, sheet, cols = 4:ncol(data), widths = 22)
  setRowHeights(wb, sheet, rows = 3, heights = 42)
  freezePane(wb, sheet, firstActiveRow = 4, firstActiveCol = 3)
}
excel_file <- file.path(output_dir, "Model_A_tables.xlsx")
saveWorkbook(wb, excel_file, overwrite = TRUE)
message("Saved Word tables: ", normalizePath(word_file))
message("Saved Excel tables: ", normalizePath(excel_file))
```

```{r}
# Model B1-1 to B1-4 and Model B2 supplementary tables
# Run this entire script in RStudio with Source.
# Results are organised from the fitted-model Excel exports, without refitting.
# Input filenames below contain no extra parenthesised suffixes.

# 1. File locations --------------------------------------------------------
data_dir <- "/Users/apple/Desktop/Bag/rolling/Postgraduate/ADV/Week 4/data"
output_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "outputs")

# Optional command-line use:
# Rscript Model_B_tables.R "/path/to/data" "/path/to/output"
arguments <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(arguments) >= 1) data_dir <- arguments[1]
if (length(arguments) >= 2) output_dir <- arguments[2]
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ever_file <- file.path(data_dir, "Model B1_Ever_ADL_IADL_Cox_results.xlsx")
never_file <- file.path(data_dir, "Model B1_Never_ADL_IADL_Cox_results.xlsx")
interaction_file <- file.path(data_dir, "B_Interaction_outputs",
                               "Model B2_Dibao_Interaction_results.xlsx")
stopifnot(file.exists(ever_file), file.exists(never_file),
          file.exists(interaction_file))

# 2. Packages --------------------------------------------------------------
packages <- c("readxl", "officer", "flextable", "openxlsx")
local_library <- file.path(getwd(), "work", "R-library")
dir.create(local_library, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
.libPaths(c(local_library, .libPaths()))
missing_packages <- packages[
  !vapply(packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org",
                   lib = local_library)
}
for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop(paste("Package could not be loaded:", pkg,
               "Please check the installation message above."))
  }
}
library(readxl)
library(officer)
library(flextable)
library(openxlsx)

# 3. Read the numeric source results ---------------------------------------
ever_full <- as.data.frame(read_excel(ever_file, sheet = "Full_Cox_Results"))
never_full <- as.data.frame(read_excel(never_file, sheet = "Full_Cox_Results"))
ever_sample <- as.data.frame(read_excel(ever_file, sheet = "Model_Comparison"))
never_sample <- as.data.frame(read_excel(never_file, sheet = "Model_Comparison"))
b2 <- as.data.frame(read_excel(interaction_file, sheet = "Primary_Level_HRs"))
blocks <- as.data.frame(read_excel(interaction_file, sheet = "Primary_Block"))
samples <- as.data.frame(read_excel(interaction_file, sheet = "Sample_Summary"))
sample_check <- as.data.frame(
  read_excel(interaction_file, sheet = "Phase1_B1_Check")
)

# Original_M1 is Model A on its original sample; it is not B1-1.
model_codes <- c("Common_M1", "M2_ADL", "M3_IADL", "M4_ADL_IADL")
model_labels <- c("B1-1", "B1-2", "B1-3", "B1-4")
model_descriptions <- c("Sociodemographic factors on the common sample",
                        "Sociodemographic factors and ADL",
                        "Sociodemographic factors and IADL",
                        "Sociodemographic factors with ADL and IADL")

# Check that the four B1 models and B2 use the same group-specific samples.
stopifnot(nrow(samples) == 2, nrow(sample_check) == 2,
          setequal(samples$group, c("Never", "Ever")),
          all(sample_check$status == "PASS"),
          all(sample_check$B1_workbook_found))
for (group in c("Never", "Ever")) {
  comparison <- if (group == "Never") never_sample else ever_sample
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(comparison$Model),
            all(model_codes %in% comparison$Model))
  comparison <- comparison[match(model_codes, comparison$Model), ]
  summary_row <- samples[samples$group == group, ]
  stopifnot(all(comparison$Persons == summary_row$persons),
            all(comparison$Intervals == summary_row$intervals),
            all(comparison$Deaths == summary_row$deaths),
            all(abs(comparison$Person_years - summary_row$person_years) < 1e-6))
}

# 4. Labels and row order ---------------------------------------------------
factor_order <- c("sex", "income_tertile", "marriage_status",
                  "living_children", "coresident_child", "hukou", "adl", "iadl")
group_labels <- c(
  sex = "Sex (reference Male)",
  income_tertile = "Income (reference T1)",
  marriage_status = "Marital status (reference Partnered)",
  living_children = "Living children (reference 0)",
  coresident_child = "Child coresidence (reference No)",
  hukou = "Hukou (reference Non-agricultural)",
  adl = "ADL", iadl = "IADL"
)
labels1 <- data.frame(
  factor = c("sex", rep("income_tertile", 2), rep("marriage_status", 3),
             rep("living_children", 4), rep("coresident_child", 2),
             "hukou", "adl", "iadl"),
  term = c("sexFemale", "income_tertileT2", "income_tertileT3",
           "marriage_statusWidowed", "marriage_statusSeparated-Divorced",
           "marriage_statusNever married", "living_children1",
           "living_children2", "living_children3+", "living_childrenUnknown",
           "coresident_childYes", "coresident_childUnknown",
           "hukouAgricultural", "adl", "iadl"),
  label = c("Female", "T2", "T3", "Widowed", "Separated/Divorced",
            "Never married", "1 child", "2 children", "3+ children", "Unknown",
            "Yes", "Unknown", "Agricultural",
            "Per 1-point increase", "Per 1-point increase"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
labels2 <- data.frame(
  factor = c("sex", rep("income_tertile", 2), rep("marriage_status", 3),
             rep("living_children", 3), "coresident_child", "hukou", "adl", "iadl"),
  comparison = c("Female vs Male", "T2 vs T1", "T3 vs T1",
                 "Widowed vs Partnered", "Separated-Divorced vs Partnered",
                 "Never married vs Partnered", "1 vs 0", "2 vs 0", "3+ vs 0",
                 "Yes vs No", "Agricultural vs Non-agricultural",
                 "ADL per 1 point", "IADL per 1 point"),
  label = c("Female", "T2", "T3", "Widowed", "Separated/Divorced",
            "Never married", "1 child", "2 children", "3+ children",
            "Yes", "Agricultural", "Per 1-point increase", "Per 1-point increase"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
model_terms <- list(labels1$term[1:13], labels1$term[1:14],
                    labels1$term[c(1:13, 15)], labels1$term)

# 5. Numeric checks and display formats ------------------------------------
check_cox <- function(data) {
  columns <- c("beta", "robust_se", "HR", "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value")
  stopifnot(all(columns %in% names(data)),
            all(is.finite(as.matrix(data[columns]))),
            all(data$robust_se > 0), all(data$lower_95 > 0),
            all(data$lower_95 <= data$HR), all(data$HR <= data$upper_95),
            all(data$p_value >= 0 & data$p_value <= 1),
            isTRUE(all.equal(data$HR, exp(data$beta), tolerance = 1e-7)))
}
format_hr <- function(hr, lower, upper) {
  sprintf("%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)", hr, lower, upper)
}
format_p <- function(p) {
  result <- sprintf("%.3f", p)
  near_cutoff <- p >= 0.045 & p <= 0.055
  result[near_cutoff] <- sprintf("%.4f", p[near_cutoff])
  result[p < 0.001] <- "<.001"
  sub("^0", "", result)
}

# 6. Four B1 tables with Never on the left and Ever on the right -------------
tables <- list()
group_rows <- list()
b1_numeric <- data.frame()
for (m in seq_along(model_codes)) {
  code <- model_codes[m]
  label <- model_labels[m]
  terms <- model_terms[[m]]
  labels <- labels1[match(terms, labels1$term), ]
  never <- never_full[never_full$Model == code, ]
  ever <- ever_full[ever_full$Model == code, ]
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(never$term), !anyDuplicated(ever$term),
            setequal(never$term, terms), setequal(ever$term, terms))
  never <- never[match(terms, never$term), ]
  ever <- ever[match(terms, ever$term), ]
  check_cox(never)
  check_cox(ever)

  numeric_data <- data.frame(
    Model = label, Source_model = code, Factor = labels$factor,
    Comparison = labels$label, Term = terms,
    Never_beta = never$beta, Never_robust_se = never$robust_se,
    Never_HR = never$HR, Never_lower_95 = never$lower_95,
    Never_upper_95 = never$upper_95, Never_p = never$p_value,
    Ever_beta = ever$beta, Ever_robust_se = ever$robust_se,
    Ever_HR = ever$HR, Ever_lower_95 = ever$lower_95,
    Ever_upper_95 = ever$upper_95, Ever_p = ever$p_value,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  b1_numeric <- rbind(b1_numeric, numeric_data)
  display <- data.frame(
    Comparison = paste0("  ", labels$label),
    Never_HR_CI = format_hr(never$HR, never$lower_95, never$upper_95),
    Never_p = format_p(never$p_value),
    Ever_HR_CI = format_hr(ever$HR, ever$lower_95, ever$upper_95),
    Ever_p = format_p(ever$p_value), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  table <- display[0, ]
  groups <- integer()
  for (factor_name in factor_order[factor_order %in% labels$factor]) {
    groups <- c(groups, nrow(table) + 1L)
    heading <- data.frame(Comparison = unname(group_labels[factor_name]),
                          Never_HR_CI = "", Never_p = "",
                          Ever_HR_CI = "", Ever_p = "")
    table <- rbind(table, heading, display[labels$factor == factor_name, ])
  }
  tables[[label]] <- table
  group_rows[[label]] <- groups
}

# 7. B2 primary interaction table -----------------------------------------
stopifnot(all(b2$analysis == "Primary_Substantive"),
          all(blocks$analysis == "Primary_Substantive"),
          all(blocks$status == "OK"),
          !anyDuplicated(b2$comparison), !anyDuplicated(blocks$factor),
          setequal(b2$comparison, labels2$comparison),
          setequal(blocks$factor, factor_order))
b2 <- b2[match(labels2$comparison, b2$comparison), ]
blocks <- blocks[match(factor_order, blocks$factor), ]
stopifnot(identical(b2$factor, labels2$factor))
b2_columns <- c("Never_HR", "Never_lower_95", "Never_upper_95", "Never_p",
                "Ever_HR", "Ever_lower_95", "Ever_upper_95", "Ever_p",
                "HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never", "ratio_lower_95", "ratio_upper_95",
                "interaction_p")
stopifnot(all(is.finite(as.matrix(b2[b2_columns]))),
          all(is.finite(as.matrix(blocks[c("chisq", "df", "p_value", "holm_p")]))),
          all(blocks$p_value >= 0 & blocks$p_value <= 1),
          all(b2$interaction_p >= 0 & b2$interaction_p <= 1),
          isTRUE(all.equal(b2$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never,
                           b2$Ever_HR / b2$Never_HR, tolerance = 1e-7)),
          isTRUE(all.equal(blocks$holm_p, p.adjust(blocks$p_value, "holm"),
                           tolerance = 1e-7)))
for (group in c("Never", "Ever")) {
  stopifnot(all(b2[[paste0(group, "_lower_95")]] > 0),
            all(b2[[paste0(group, "_lower_95")]] <= b2[[paste0(group, "_HR")]]),
            all(b2[[paste0(group, "_HR")]] <= b2[[paste0(group, "_upper_95")]]),
            all(b2[[paste0(group, "_p")]] >= 0 & b2[[paste0(group, "_p")]] <= 1))
}
stopifnot(all(b2$ratio_lower_95 > 0),
          all(b2$ratio_lower_95 <= b2$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never),
          all(b2$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never <= b2$ratio_upper_95))
b2_display <- data.frame(
  Comparison = paste0("  ", labels2$label),
  Never_HR_CI = format_hr(b2$Never_HR, b2$Never_lower_95, b2$Never_upper_95),
  Ever_HR_CI = format_hr(b2$Ever_HR, b2$Ever_lower_95, b2$Ever_upper_95),
  RHR_CI = format_hr(b2$HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never,
                     b2$ratio_lower_95, b2$ratio_upper_95),
  Contrast_p = format_p(b2$interaction_p), Overall_p = "",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
table <- b2_display[0, ]
groups <- integer()
for (factor_name in factor_order) {
  groups <- c(groups, nrow(table) + 1L)
  heading <- data.frame(
    Comparison = unname(group_labels[factor_name]),
    Never_HR_CI = "", Ever_HR_CI = "", RHR_CI = "", Contrast_p = "",
    Overall_p = format_p(blocks$p_value[blocks$factor == factor_name])
  )
  table <- rbind(table, heading, b2_display[labels2$factor == factor_name, ])
}
tables[["B2"]] <- table
group_rows[["B2"]] <- groups

# 8. Titles, notes and column labels ---------------------------------------
titles <- c(paste("Table", model_labels, model_descriptions),
             "Table B2 Model B2 between-group differences in mortality associations")
names(titles) <- names(tables)
sample_note <- sprintf(
  "Never Dibao: %s respondents and %s deaths. Ever Dibao: %s respondents and %s deaths.",
  format(samples$persons[samples$group == "Never"], big.mark = ","),
  format(samples$deaths[samples$group == "Never"], big.mark = ","),
  format(samples$persons[samples$group == "Ever"], big.mark = ","),
  format(samples$deaths[samples$group == "Ever"], big.mark = ",")
)
adjustment_notes <- c(
  "B1-1 included the six sociodemographic factors.",
  "B1-2 additionally included ADL.",
  "B1-3 additionally included IADL.",
  "B1-4 additionally included both ADL and IADL."
)
notes <- character(5)
for (m in seq_along(model_codes)) {
  notes[m] <- paste(
    sample_note, "HR = hazard ratio. CI = confidence interval.",
    "All B1 models used a common sample with ADL and IADL observed at interval start.",
    adjustment_notes[m],
    "Separate Cox models were stratified by age group; standard errors were clustered by individual.",
    "Unknown child-number and coresidence categories were retained as adjustment terms."
  )
  if (m > 1) notes[m] <- paste(notes[m], "Functional-score HRs represent a one-point increase.")
}
notes[5] <- paste(
  sample_note, "HR = hazard ratio. CI = confidence interval. RHR = Ever Dibao HR / Never Dibao HR.",
  "Each model tested one factor's interaction with Dibao group, adjusting for all eight factors.",
  "Baseline hazards were stratified by age group and Dibao group; other factor coefficients were shared.",
  "Standard errors were clustered by individual. Functional-score HRs represent a one-point increase.",
  "Contrast p is category-specific; overall p is the factor-level Wald test.",
  "Displayed p values are unadjusted. Holm-adjusted overall p values are retained in the Excel B2_tests sheet.",
  "Unknown categories were adjustment terms without group interactions."
)
names(notes) <- names(tables)
headers1 <- c(Comparison = "Variable or contrast", Never_HR_CI = "HR (95% CI)",
              Never_p = "p", Ever_HR_CI = "HR (95% CI)", Ever_p = "p")
headers2 <- c(Comparison = "Variable or contrast",
              Never_HR_CI = "Never Dibao\nHR (95% CI)",
              Ever_HR_CI = "Ever Dibao\nHR (95% CI)",
              RHR_CI = "Ever/Never\nRHR (95% CI)",
              Contrast_p = "Contrast\np", Overall_p = "Overall\np")
excel_headers1 <- c(Comparison = "Variable or contrast",
                    Never_HR_CI = "Never Dibao HR (95% CI)", Never_p = "Never Dibao p",
                    Ever_HR_CI = "Ever Dibao HR (95% CI)", Ever_p = "Ever Dibao p")

# 9. Editable Word tables --------------------------------------------------
make_word_table <- function(data, headers, groups, widths) {
  ft <- flextable(data)
  ft <- set_header_labels(ft, values = as.list(headers))
  ft <- theme_booktabs(ft)
  ft <- font(ft, fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all")
  ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 12, part = "all")
  ft <- color(ft, color = "black", part = "all")
  ft <- bold(ft, part = "header")
  ft <- bold(ft, i = groups, part = "body")
  ft <- align(ft, align = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- align(ft, j = 1, align = "left", part = "all")
  ft <- valign(ft, valign = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- padding(ft, padding = 0.75, part = "all")
  ft <- height(ft, height = 0.22, part = "body")
  ft <- hrule(ft, rule = "auto", part = "body")
  ft <- width(ft, j = seq_along(widths), width = widths)
  ft <- set_table_properties(ft, layout = "fixed", align = "center",
                            opts_word = list(split = FALSE))
  paginate(ft, init = FALSE, hdr_ftr = TRUE)
}
title_style <- fp_text(font.family = "Times New Roman", font.size = 12, bold = TRUE)
note_style <- fp_text(font.family = "Times New Roman", font.size = 12)
doc <- read_docx()
doc <- body_set_default_section(doc, prop_section(
  page_size = page_size(orient = "landscape"),
  page_margins = page_mar(top = 0.5, bottom = 0.5, left = 0.65, right = 0.65)
))
for (label in names(tables)) {
  if (label != names(tables)[1]) doc <- body_add_break(doc)
  if (label == "B2") {
    ft <- make_word_table(tables[[label]], headers2, group_rows[[label]],
                           c(3.0, 1.75, 1.75, 1.75, 0.85, 0.85))
  } else {
    ft <- make_word_table(tables[[label]], headers1, group_rows[[label]],
                           c(3.5, 2.3, 0.8, 2.3, 0.8))
    ft <- add_header_row(ft, values = c("", "Never Dibao", "Ever Dibao"),
                         colwidths = c(1, 2, 2), top = TRUE)
    ft <- bold(ft, part = "header")
    ft <- align(ft, align = "center", part = "header")
    ft <- align(ft, j = 1, align = "left", part = "header")
    ft <- italic(ft, j = c(3, 5), i = 2, part = "header")
  }
  doc <- body_add_fpar(doc, fpar(ftext(titles[label], title_style),
                                fp_p = fp_par(keep_with_next = TRUE)))
  doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft)
  doc <- body_add_fpar(doc, fpar(ftext(notes[label], note_style),
                                fp_p = fp_par(line_spacing = 1)))
}
word_file <- file.path(output_dir, "Model_B_tables.docx")
print(doc, target = word_file)

# 10. Excel presentation tables and unrounded numeric results ---------------
wb <- createWorkbook()
modifyBaseFont(wb, fontSize = 12, fontName = "Times New Roman")
header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center",
                             valign = "center", wrapText = TRUE, border = "bottom")
group_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold")
note_style_xlsx <- createStyle(wrapText = TRUE, valign = "top")
p_style <- createStyle(numFmt = "0.000000E+00")
number_style <- createStyle(numFmt = "0.000000")
for (label in names(tables)) {
  data <- tables[[label]]
  names(data) <- if (label == "B2") unname(headers2) else unname(excel_headers1)
  widths <- if (label == "B2") c(48, 29, 29, 29, 15, 15) else c(48, 29, 17, 29, 17)
  addWorksheet(wb, label, gridLines = FALSE)
  writeData(wb, label, titles[label], startRow = 1, colNames = FALSE)
  mergeCells(wb, label, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), rows = 1)
  addStyle(wb, label, group_style, rows = 1, cols = 1)
  writeData(wb, label, data, startRow = 3, headerStyle = header_style)
  addStyle(wb, label, group_style, rows = group_rows[[label]] + 3,
           cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
  setColWidths(wb, label, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), widths = widths)
  setRowHeights(wb, label, rows = 3, heights = 36)
  setRowHeights(wb, label, rows = 4:(nrow(data) + 3), heights = 22)
  note_row <- nrow(data) + 5
  writeData(wb, label, notes[label], startRow = note_row, colNames = FALSE)
  mergeCells(wb, label, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), rows = note_row)
  addStyle(wb, label, note_style_xlsx, rows = note_row, cols = 1)
  setRowHeights(wb, label, rows = note_row, heights = 125)
  freezePane(wb, label, firstActiveRow = 4, firstActiveCol = 2)
  pageSetup(wb, label, orientation = "landscape", paperSize = 9,
            fitToWidth = TRUE, fitToHeight = FALSE)
}
numeric_tables <- list(B1_numeric = b1_numeric, B2_numeric = b2, B2_tests = blocks)
source_notes <- c(
  B1_numeric = paste("Sources: Model B1_Never_ADL_IADL_Cox_results.xlsx and",
                      "Model B1_Ever_ADL_IADL_Cox_results.xlsx; Full_Cox_Results."),
  B2_numeric = "Source: Model B2_Dibao_Interaction_results.xlsx; Primary_Level_HRs.",
  B2_tests = paste("Source: Model B2_Dibao_Interaction_results.xlsx; Primary_Block.",
                    "holm_p is adjusted across the eight primary factor-level tests.")
)
for (sheet in names(numeric_tables)) {
  data <- numeric_tables[[sheet]]
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet, gridLines = FALSE)
  writeData(wb, sheet, source_notes[sheet], startRow = 1, colNames = FALSE)
  writeData(wb, sheet, data, startRow = 3, headerStyle = header_style)
  numeric_cols <- which(vapply(data, is.numeric, logical(1)))
  addStyle(wb, sheet, number_style, rows = 4:(nrow(data) + 3),
           cols = numeric_cols, gridExpand = TRUE)
  p_cols <- grep("(_p$|^p_value$)", names(data))
  addStyle(wb, sheet, p_style, rows = 4:(nrow(data) + 3),
           cols = p_cols, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
  setColWidths(wb, sheet, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), widths = 23)
  if (sheet == "B1_numeric") setColWidths(wb, sheet, cols = 4:5, widths = c(30, 43))
  if (sheet == "B2_numeric") setColWidths(wb, sheet, cols = 3, widths = 43)
  setRowHeights(wb, sheet, rows = 3, heights = 42)
  freezePane(wb, sheet, firstActiveRow = 4, firstActiveCol = 3)
}
excel_file <- file.path(output_dir, "Model_B_tables.xlsx")
saveWorkbook(wb, excel_file, overwrite = TRUE)
message("Saved Word tables: ", normalizePath(word_file))
message("Saved Excel tables: ", normalizePath(excel_file))
```
